show.title: SIGNAL 309
show.author: Hummingbird
show.summary: In 1987, lightning burned out a small-town Texas radio tower and left a hole in the dial. Every night at 3:09 a.m., 1690 AM carries the evening news from Aster, a world one step over from ours. Some nights it carries something worse: calls from our own past, live, from people who can hear you answer. A serialized sci-fi mystery audio drama with a cipher hidden in every episode. All stories are fiction; voices are AI-generated. Stay tuned to 1690.

episodes.title: Episode 1: "1690"
episodes.summary: Every night at 3:09 a.m., a radio station that went silent in 1987 broadcasts nine minutes of tomorrow's news. Tonight, a 911 dispatcher hears it, and it says her name.

episodes.title: The Concord Hour 1: News From Another World
episodes.summary: The dead station on 1690 picks up the evening news from Aster: a galactic council debating the Quiet World, 40,000 refugees at a closed border, an election with a candidate who isn't a person. And at the end, a message for us.

episodes.title: Drift 1: "105 and Rising"
episodes.summary: At 3:09 a.m. the radio plays helicopters, rockets, and a 21-year-old Marine radioman on a Saigon rooftop on April 29, 1975, calling a Texas station. Then he hears the dispatcher answer. The characters are fiction; the evacuation signal is real history.
